title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies - Antonyms
subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to the bolded word:

After waking up from the drug-induced coma, the young addict was surprisingly **lucid**.
questions.explain: 'Lucid' means expressed clearly or easy to understand, and in a medical context, it means possessing full use of one's faculties or being mentally clear. Its direct opposite is 'confused' or disoriented.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to the bolded word:

The highway patrol intercepted the commercial driver due to his exceptionally **erratic** driving and random lane changes.
questions.explain: 'Erratic' means lacking a regular, consistent, or predictable course or pattern. Its opposite is 'steady', which means firmly controlled and consistent.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to the bolded word:

The consumer protection agency launched an operation targeting vendors knowingly distributing **counterfeit** pharmaceutical drugs.
questions.explain: In consumer protection, 'counterfeit' refers to fraudulent, forged, or fake items. Its precise antonym is 'authentic' or genuine.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to the bolded word:

Civil rights activists passionately protested against the draconian proposed legislation that systematically sought to **curtail** the freedom of the press.
questions.explain: To 'curtail' means to heavily reduce, restrict, or deprive someone of something. The clear antonym is to 'expand' or increase it.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to the bolded word:

The presiding high court judge was publicly petitioned for being heavily **biased** against female plaintiffs during inheritance litigation proceedings.
questions.explain: Being 'biased' means unfairly prejudiced for or against someone or a group. The definitive antonym in a legal/gender context is 'impartial', signifying complete neutrality and fairness.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies
